title: Comparing Quantities and Expectations
goal: Compare outcomes against projections using de lo que, agreeing del que forms, que and de before numbers.
grammar: comparisons with de lo que and del que

items: I can compare an outcome with a forecast clause using *más de lo que* and *menos de lo que*.
I can match *del que*, *de la que*, *de los que* and *de las que* to the noun being compared.
I can choose *que* between two items and *de* before an affirmative number.
